alternative_fix_sites: tally/payments.py::PaymentBook._apply (post the entry before settling the invoices, so nothing needs undoing)
notes: The undo path after a failed posting reverses the payment but adds the early payment discount a second time instead of removing it. Only reachable when a payment that earns a discount is rejected (closed period); rejected payments without a discount restore correctly (public test and a regression probe). The invoice then looks discounted, loses its discount eligibility, and the subledger disagrees with the receivables account. Dropping the 'discount at most once' check masks the re-payment symptom but still fails probe_rejected_discount_payment_restores_invoice.
